$comment: Declared, non-metered costs. Anything that cannot be pulled from a provider
billing API lives here so the total-cost view is complete and auditable.
- Every entry needs a source: a real invoice or billing page, not a memory.
- `verified_on` is the date the amount was last checked against that source.
The digest flags any entry older than 90 days as stale rather than
silently reporting a number nobody has confirmed this quarter.
- `amount_usd` is per `period`. Annual plans are recorded annually and
amortized by the renderer, not pre-divided here.
- Set `active: false` rather than deleting, so history stays reconstructable.
TO ADD A COST: copy an entry, fill it in, set verified_on to today.
